title: a11y_reduced/30000ms.png is a solid-black frame blessed as a T2 golden
evidence: Pixel census of the file: all 921600 px are RGB (0,0,0). Diff hunk shows only its sibling re-rendered: 'goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png      | Bin 69937 -> 70241 bytes'; 30000ms is absent from 0431813's list. In-branch 49db920 held the real scene: 'goldens/a11y_reduced/30000ms.png      | Bin 70630 -> 70570 bytes'.
detail: A fully-black capture was blessed where the identical a11y scene (deutan/protan/tritan/scale 30000ms) renders the parchment neighborhood; reduced-motion only pins pulse/camera easing. The byte-exact local gate can never pass this frame with any working renderer.
recommended_fix: Recapture goldens/a11y_reduced/30000ms.png with the working renderer (tools/harness.sh save a11y_reduced) and add an all-black corpus guard to check_golden so a broken readback can never be blessed.

title: T2 corpus flipped to R/B-swapped pixel convention; the pinned local harness fails it wholesale
evidence: app/render/palette.odin:195: p.canvas = jcol(obj, "canvas", {237, 226, 200, 255}). Pre-PR blessed corpus (git show 7f14611:goldens/qos/65000ms.png) stores bg (237,226,200); current tree stores (200,226,237) in 116/117 PNGs. Fresh tools/build_raylib_sw.sh + harness run: 'got bg (237, 226, 200) want bg (200, 226, 237)' and 'T2 30000ms: 921600/921600 pixels differ (bbox [0, 0, 1279, 719])' on every sampled demo.
detail: The entire T2 corpus this lane blessed is channel-swapped versus the code's canvas constant, the whole pre-PR corpus, the sibling 49db920 re-bless, and a fresh pinned rlsw build. The documented local recipe (the merge ground truth) fails every T2 frame from a fresh checkout; CI cannot catch it (--skip-raster).
recommended_fix: Re-bless the whole corpus with the documented pinned recipe (tools/harness.sh save under the rlsw shadow) so the stored convention matches tools/harness.sh run; prove green from a fresh shadow before merge.

title: 16 pulse-shifted goldens clobbered by the rebase were never re-rendered
evidence: 49db920: 'Same 18-demo set, 33 PNGs: every shifted pixel is the congested halo's INTENSITY moving ... at the capture tick's pulse phase'. 0431813 re-rendered 27; comm(49db920 set minus 0431813 set) = 16 (a11y_{protan,reduced,scale,tritan}/30000ms, juice/30000ms, legacy_decay/60000ms, pause/65000+80000ms, qos/65000ms, qos_emphasis/12000ms, sla/01000ms, advance_block_sla/15000ms, advance_fire/60000ms, health_lose/21000ms, surge/30000ms, warn/45000ms). Sampled 8 are byte-identical to ad8afca (pre-pulse) blobs; deutan/30000 ad8afca->0431813 diff = 2143 px (max delta 26, bbox 644,356-921,483) is exactly this pulse shift.
detail: The rebase replayed the box lane's re-bless blobs over the sibling's pulse re-bless; the re-render commit reconciled only 27 of the 33 conflicted frames. The 16 hold pre-pulse bytes the merged build no longer renders, so the local T2 gate is red for them even in the blessing env.
recommended_fix: Re-render the 16 remaining frames with the merged build and correct the PR's re-bless inventory disclosure to cover all 33 conflicted frames, not 27.

title: dots_post_crisis comment misstates the measured semantics
evidence: dots_post_crisis: i32, // dots AFTER the last crisis resolved (the no-death-spiral recovery) ... if stats.saw_crisis_active do stats.dots_post_crisis += 1 ... if len(s.crisis.active) > 0 do stats.saw_crisis_active = true
detail: saw_crisis_active latches on first crisis onset and never clears, so dots DURING the crisis count too; the comment claims 'after the last crisis resolved'. The death-spiral gate still works, but the calibration evidence misdescribes itself.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to 'dots after the first crisis onset', or clear saw_crisis_active when the crisis resolves if post-resolution recovery is the intended measure.
